findings.title: Public functions removed/renamed without updating other callers or tests
findings.body: The PR deletes mark_failed_threshold, create_issue_platform_occurrence, get_failure_reason, get_monitor_environment_context, the HUMAN_FAILURE_STATUS_MAP constants and SimpleCheckIn from mark_failed.py. It renames them in the new modules (try_incident_threshold, create_incident_occurrence) and does not re-export them. The diff touches no other files, so existing imports from sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed (tests, other modules) will raise ImportError, and tests that patch 'sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.*' will fail. Update the callers and tests, or keep compatibility aliases.

findings.title: Copied config is computed but the uncopied config is returned
findings.body: get_monitor_environment_context copies the config and replaces schedule_type with its display value. The returned dict then uses monitor.config (the original) instead of the local copy, so the display conversion is never applied. This bug existed before the move, but the PR carries it over unchanged. It should return `config`.
